sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops evaluation when any link in the chain is nil
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through a chain of connections, but if any single link is gone, the whole gesture dissolves into nothing.

sketches.mechanism: The 'never' return type indicates a function that can never successfully return — the type system enforces the impossibility
sketches.resonance: A promise whose type signature guarantees it cannot be kept.

sketches.mechanism: A synchronized block acquires a lock on an object — two threads entering synchronized(heart) will block, only one can hold it at a time
sketches.resonance: Two people reaching for the same heart: one must wait, and waiting is enforced by the language itself.
